Dormant: No settled purchase (amount>0, no error) in Nov 2018–Oct 2019.
Established credit-led: ≥9 distinct purchase months in window AND credit purchase volume ≥ 50% of total purchase volume.
Established debit/prepaid-led: ≥9 distinct purchase months in window AND credit purchase volume < 50% of total purchase volume.
Other active: Has ≥1 settled purchase in window but <9 purchase months (residual).
